meta.title: Café & Pâtisserie in Tel Aviv – Platters & Event Catering | Uzi & Galit
meta.description: Uzi & Galit is a neighbourhood café and pâtisserie at 8 Aharon Becker St (Mikado centre), Tel Aviv. Fresh pastries, sandwiches, salads, dairy party platters, picnic baskets and event catering. Order on WhatsApp.

about.title: Uzi & Galit, a neighbourhood café.
about.text: The café grew out of a love of hosting and good food, on Aharon Becker Street in the Mikado shopping centre. Locals, people who work nearby and anyone passing by for a quick coffee all get the same warm welcome.

items.q: How far ahead should I order a platter?
items.a: A day ahead for most platters. For big events or a Friday morning, message us a few days before.
Yes. Order the daily menu on Wolt, and platters or baskets on WhatsApp for pick-up or delivery. Delivery areas and fees are given when we confirm your order.
The kitchen is dairy and holds a kashrut certificate. For details about the certifying body, ask us at the café or on WhatsApp.
Everything is dairy and vegetarian, with a vegan sandwich and cakes and cookies with no added sugar. Gluten-free: our kitchen isn't sterile, so we have nothing safe for coeliacs.
Dishes may contain gluten, milk, eggs, nuts and sesame. Write your allergy in the order notes and we'll tell you what works.
At the café, you pay on the spot. For platters and events, we agree on payment when we confirm the order.
